verdict.rationale: Wise Business issues cards and documents APIs to retrieve card transactions, webhook subscriptions and statement exports. None of the evidence describes automatic receipt capture or expense coding at the moment of card use. Transaction APIs and webhooks are only developer building blocks a user could build on, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have receipts automatically captured and coded the moment a card is used, without manual entry
